commands.title: Commands
commands.about: The engine registry. A script is deterministic mechanics, run by the panel. A model is work with meaning: the panel shows the procedure, the assistant performs it.
commands.ns.kit: kit: the engine and the project
commands.ns.kb: kb: extracting knowledge and its life
commands.net.type_hint: A display label: 1 — depends on sources or the network, 2 — on the model, 3 — on neither. The label does not decide whether the command runs.
commands.net.vpn_hint: The connection profiles without which this command's sources in the project are unavailable.
commands.net.llm_hint: The command needs the kit's model: any available provider of the role's chain will do.
commands.net.llm_vpn: The command needs the kit's model; the providers live behind profiles: {names}
commands.net.offline_hint: The command needs no sources, no model and no internet: it works in the offline mode too.
commands.net.needs_net_hint: The command needs sources, the model or the internet: without a connection the panel offers to run only what is available or to queue.
commands.net.variant_hint: A variant of the command that works without a connection.
commands.net.variant.parse_downloaded: offline: parse what is already downloaded
commands.net.sources_hint: Which of the project's sources the command uses.
